title: bandolier catalogue output
description: Every service type the catalogue defines (cli-spec.md §4.1), and which file answered. The app offers this list when attaching a service (app-spec.md §6) and when creating a project (§8); without it the app would have to hold its own copy of the catalogue, which is the desync §4.1 exists to prevent.

origin.description: Which step of the §4.1 resolution chain answered.

services.description: Every catalogue entry, sorted by key.

catalogue_service.description: One service type as the catalogue defines it. Ports here are the DEFINITION (§4.1): container_port is fixed, host_port_base only starts the allocator's search (§5) — a project's actual host port comes from its manifest, never from here.

host_port_base.description: Start of this service's host-port band (§5). NOT an assigned port.
